channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula cita Flamengo e Corinthians e diz estar decidido a 'acabar com bets'
item.description: At a rally in Guarulhos, Lula (PT) criticized betting houses and mentioned Flamengo and Corinthians, reinforcing his stance against 'bets' following a club manifesto. He took a firm tone to appeal to voters concerned about the rise of illegal gambling.

item.title: Em comício, Tebet acena a mulheres, ataca Derrite e associa Flávio a Master
item.description: Simone Tebet spoke at a campaign rally in Guarulhos alongside Lula, attacking political opponents and linking adversaries to controversial figures. She also criticized the previous government and emphasized women's participation in politics.

item.title: Haddad ao eleitorado paulistano: Realizem o sonho do Tarcísio que é ir embora de SP
item.description: Fernando Haddad, the PT candidate for governor of São Paulo, said at a rally in Guarulhos that voters should fulfill Tarcísio de Freitas's wish of leaving the state. The remark was an indirect reference to the governor, who is seeking reelection under the Republicanos party. Haddad emphasized the importance of popular participation to change the direction of the state government.

item.title: Anúncio de reajuste do Bolsa Família gera desinformação nas redes sociais
item.description: President Lula announced a 15% adjustment to the Bolsa Família program, sparking political reactions and a wave of misinformation on social media. The measure, released 17 days before the first round of elections, became the target of fact-checks due to misleading content. The announcement reinforces the social agenda of the reelection candidate.

item.title: "Quem legalizou o Master foi o Bolsonaro", diz Lula em ato de campanha
item.description: Lula attributed the Master Bank scandal to the previous Bolsonaro administration, highlighting that Vorcaro was arrested during his tenure. The re-election candidate also distanced himself from the INSS scheme, accusing Flávio Bolsonaro of ties to the 'Careca'. Alckmin and Tebet reinforced the accusations as the 2026 election debate intensified with a focus on corruption.

item.title: Tebet diz que Flávio não pode ir às urnas sem explicar Master
item.description: Simone Tebet (PSB) stated that Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) must clarify his ties to the Banco Master and Daniel Vorcaro before the elections. Speaking in Guarulhos (SP), she praised Lula's policies such as raising the minimum wage and tax exemptions on essential goods.

item.title: Tarcísio deixou SP “de pires na mão” e é ingrato com Lula, diz Haddad
item.description: Haddad criticized Tarcísio for leaving São Paulo 'in disarray' and called him ungrateful to Lula, highlighting federal support for the state. He emphasized federal actions such as increased BNDES funding and debt renegotiation, demanding transparency from the governor.

item.title: STF rejeita recurso e mantém condenação de Eduardo por coação
item.description: The First Chamber of the Supreme Federal Court (STF) unanimously rejected the appeal filed by the defense of Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP) and upheld his conviction to four years and two months in prison for coercion. The ruling was issued on Friday, the 18th, concluding the hearing on the objections of notice. The case refers to a criminal action involving coercion during the proceedings.

item.title: “Decidi que vou acabar com as bets”, diz Lula
item.description: At a campaign rally in Guarulhos, Lula pledged to shut down sports betting companies to fight money laundering and household debt, reinforcing his anti-bets rhetoric.

item.title: 1ª Turma mantém condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro por obstrução
item.description: The STF's First Chamber upheld Eduardo Bolsonaro's 4-year and 2-month sentence for obstruction of justice, rejecting the DPU's appeal to reduce the penalty. Minister Alexandre de Moraes emphasized that the former federal deputy's statements do not constitute spontaneous confession, making the mitigating factor inadmissible. The ruling addressed declaration objections, with votes acknowledging a confession but understanding the sentence already accounted for it.

item.title: 'O estado saiu do vermelho', diz o governador em exercício, Ricardo Couto, durante evento no Rio com presidente Lula
item.description: Interim governor Ricardo Couto said at an event with President Lula that Rio de Janeiro state has moved out of fiscal deficit and reached a budget surplus, reversing a projected deficit of 18.9 billion reais. He highlighted cost-cutting measures such as the elimination of vacant executive positions.

item.title: Por unanimidade, STF rejeita recurso e mantém condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: The STF rejected by majority Eduardo Bolsonaro's appeal, upholding his four-year-two-month prison sentence for coercion during proceedings, for orchestrating tariffs against Brazilian exports to protect his father, Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Primeira Turma do STF rejeita recurso e mantém condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro por coação
item.description: The First Panel of the STF unanimously upheld the conviction of Eduardo Bolsonaro to four years and two months in prison for coercion, rejecting the appeal filed by the Defender of the Union. The former federal deputy was convicted for attempting to interfere in the trial of the coup plot case involving his father, Jair Bolsonaro. Currently abroad since February 2025, Eduardo had his term revoked for abandoning his duties in the Chamber of Deputies.

item.title: Quem são os candidatos a deputado federal por Sergipe (SE) nas eleições 2026
item.description: In the 2026 elections, over 1.7 million eligible voters in Sergipe will choose 8 federal deputies for the Chamber of Deputies in a single-round vote on October 4th. The election uses a proportional system, where votes are summed by party or federation to determine seat allocation. Among the 141 candidates are Acácio Cardoso (PSDB Cidadania), Alberto Macedo (Republicanos), Alessandra da ONG (Agir Pára o Avanço), Alex Pintado (União Brasil), Allan Marques (Novo) and Amanda Oliveira (Brasil da Esperança).

item.title: Desconfiança no STF bate recorde no Datafolha, e metade dos eleitores diz que crise influenciará voto para presidente
item.description: Datafolha survey records peak distrust in the STF (48%) and shows 47% of voters say institutional crisis will influence their presidential vote, with Lula (38%) and Flávio Bolsonaro (31%) cited as most affected.

item.title: “Vou acabar com as bets”, diz Lula em meio a polêmica com times de futebol
item.description: Lula promised to ban online betting (bets) if re-elected, during a speech in Guarulhos, criticizing it as gambling addiction harming youth. He cited conversations with young people in crisis and stated that football clubs oppose the ban due to pressure from betting companies. Lula emphasized that lives matter more than revenue, even at the cost of tax income.

item.title: Mendonça não vai comprar briga com Gilmar por conta de aumento do Bolsa Família
item.description: TSE minister André Mendonça will not proceed with the lawsuit challenging the Bolsa Família adjustment, following a favorable ruling by STF minister Gilmar Mendes. The measure, announced by Lula 17 days before the first round, was deemed an inflation correction, though critics claim electoral intent. Mendonça had previously dismissed a similar action by federal deputy Zé Trovão for lack of standing.

item.title: Datafolha: 38% dizem que crise do STF prejudica campanha de Lula
item.description: Datafolha survey reveals that 38% of voters believe the STF crisis harms Lula's reelection campaign, while 31% say Flávio Bolsonaro is most affected. The poll also shows that 2% think Ronaldo Caiado and Renan Santos are impacted by the judiciary crisis.

item.title: ‘Meu candidato chama-se Lula, todo mundo sabe disso’, diz Paes sobre ausência nas agendas do presidente no Rio
item.description: Eduardo Paes denied avoiding Lula to not lose Bolsonaro voters, stating his support for the PT candidate is public. He justified absences from the president's Rio events by electoral laws that would make him ineligible. Paes also presented health proposals, including completion of the Cancer Hospital and creation of an operations center for floods in the Serra Region.

item.title: Reajuste do Bolsa Família tira crise do STF do foco das redes sociais, mostra relatório
item.description: The announcement of the Bolsa Família adjustment, close to the first round of elections, shifted the dominant narrative on social media, which was focused on the crisis at the STF, redirecting public attention to the social agenda.

item.title: Marina se confunde e fala número de Salles durante ato em SP
item.description: During a campaign event in Guarulhos (SP), Marina Silva (Rede), candidate for the Senate, confused the ballot number, initially mentioning 300, which belongs to Ricardo Salles (Novo), before correcting herself and stating her number is 180. The event featured Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, Janja Lula da Silva, Geraldo Alckmin, Fernando Haddad, and Simone Tebet.

item.title: Datafolha: Aumento de desconfiança no STF destoa de outras instituições
item.description: 2026 Datafolha poll shows rising distrust toward the STF, diverging from stable trust in other institutions. This judicial dissatisfaction may impact discussions on reforms and legal security in the electoral context.

item.title: Datafolha: 47% dizem que crise no STF terá alguma influência no voto para presidente
item.description: Datafolha poll reveals that 47% of voters say the STF crisis and Banco Master scandal will influence their 2026 presidential vote. The survey was released on September 18, 2026.

item.title: Canetas emagrecedoras no SUS: Lula faz anúncio, mas acesso ainda não tem data
item.description: President Lula announced that weight-loss injections will be offered through the SUS, but no start date has been set. The Minister of Health emphasized that access depends on ongoing cost-effectiveness studies and clinical protocols.

item.title: "Eu não cometi crime e nada devo", diz Milton Leite ao sair de delegacia
item.description: Former councilman Milton Leite, targeted by the Vectura Corrupta operation, denied all charges upon surrendering to police in Mogi das Cruzes, asserting his innocence and trust in justice. Police considered him a fugitive and arrested him after his surrender. He was detained at the Drug Trafficking Investigation Department and sent to the Legal Medicine Institute for a autopsy.

item.title: Datafolha: 38% veem Lula como prejudicado por caos no STF, ante 31% que apontam Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Datafolha survey reveals 38% of voters see Lula (PT) harmed by STF crisis, versus 31% pointing to Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The poll surveyed 2,001 voters from Tuesday 15th to Thursday 17th, with a two-point margin of error.

item.title: Em áudio, presidente do PT proíbe divulgação de materiais sem número de Lula e candidaturas majoritárias
item.description: The PT party president banned the circulation of campaign materials that do not include Lula's number and other majoritarian candidates from the party.

item.title: Eleitores citam mais Lula do que Flávio como candidato prejudicado com a crise no STF, aponta Datafolha
item.description: Datafolha survey indicates 38% of voters see Lula as harmed by STF crisis, compared to 31% for Flávio Bolsonaro. Conducted after Supreme Court sessions, it also shows a tight second round and several low-profile candidates. The STF crisis has intensified legal debates and may impact the electoral campaign.

item.title: Datafolha: 78% dizem ter mais orgulho do que vergonha de ser brasileiro
item.description: A Datafolha survey released on September 18, 2026 reveals that 78% of respondents feel more pride than shame in being Brazilian, while 20% feel the opposite. Other responses accounted for 1%, and 2% were unsure.

item.title: Gilmar Mendes decide que reajuste no Bolsa Família é constitucional
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes ruled that the Bolsa Família adjustment is constitutional, stating it is part of implementing citizenship basic income and poverty reduction. The benefit floor will increase from R$600 to R$691, with payments starting in October. The decision followed President Lula's announcement and a request from the Attorney General's Office for constitutional recognition.

item.title: STF rejeita por unanimidade recurso de Eduardo Bolsonaro contra condenação por coação
item.description: The STF unanimously rejected the appeal filed by Eduardo Bolsonaro against his conviction for coercion, upholding his four-year and two-month prison sentence for attempting to interfere in U.S. legal proceedings related to the coup plot. Minister Alexandre de Moraes ruled that the defense failed to prove procedural flaws and denied a sentence reduction based on alleged confession.

item.title: Datafolha: 34% dizem que apoio a impeachment no STF aumenta chance de voto para senador
item.description: A Datafolha survey found that 34% of voters are more likely to support a Senate candidate who backs the impeachment of Supreme Court justices. Released on September 18, 2026, the poll highlights how judicial issues influence electoral choices. The topic is polarizing, yet reveals notable traction among a segment of the federal electorate.

item.title: STF rejeita recurso e mantém condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro por coação em processo sobre trama golpista
item.description: The STF upheld the conviction of Eduardo Bolsonaro for attempting to influence his father Jair Bolsonaro's trial in the coup plot. He will serve 4 years and 2 months in semi-open regime, 12 years of ineligibility, and a fine of R$ 162,000. The defense claimed parliamentary immunity, but Minister Moraes ruled that lobbying abroad against Brazil is incompatible with parliamentary duties.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: o placar da disputa nas regiões do Brasil, segundo pesquisa
item.description: Datafolha survey (Sep 15-17, 2,002 voters) shows technical tie nationwide: Lula 39%, Flávio 36%. Lula leads in Northeast (56% vs 26%), Flávio leads in South (45% vs 27%), Southeast (37% vs 34%) and Center-West/North (41% vs 35%).

item.title: Lula lidera o 1º turno e terá disputa apertada com Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º, mostra agregador CartaColectta
item.description: The CartaColectta aggregator projects Lula (PT) leading the first round with 39.2%, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 36.7%. In the second round, Flávio leads numerically with 45.1%, ahead of Lula (43.3%), according to weighted data from polls registered with the TSE.

item.title: AGU pede ao STF que reconheça reajuste do Bolsa Família
item.description: The AGU has requested the STF to recognize the constitutionality of the 15.04% adjustment to Bolsa Família, arguing that the update compensates for inflationary loss since March 2023 and does not constitute a disproportionate increase. The adjustment, effective in October, was challenged by Renan Santos, the Public Ministry, and the TCU.

item.title: Ex-vereador Milton Leite se entrega à polícia após operação contra PCC
item.description: Former São Paulo city councilor and chamber president Milton Leite, from União Brasil, surrendered to police after being declared a fugitive in an operation targeting the PCC in the city's public transport system. He had a temporary arrest warrant issued and will be transferred to the Mogi das Cruzes public prison, with authorities citing several clues of his involvement in the criminal scheme.

item.title: Crise no STF torna Mendonça e Moraes alvos de narrativa espiritual entre evangélicos
item.description: A crisis involving Supreme Court ministers André Mendonça and Alexandre de Moraes has been reinterpreted in spiritual terms by Evangelical groups aligned with Bolsonarism. Religious and political leaders active on social media portray Mendonça as 'chosen by God' and Moraes as a spiritual opponent, particularly after the Banco Master scandal. This narrative has gained traction among Evangelicals on social media ahead of the first electoral round.

item.title: Entenda proposta de Marinho para destravar impeachment no Senado
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN) introduced a bill to amend the Senate's Internal Rules, establishing a 30-day deadline for analyzing impeachment complaints against Supreme Court justices and allowing appeal to the full chamber if rejected. The proposal aims to expedite impeachment proceedings and currently requires only Senate approval.

item.title: Por que a AGU acionou o STF para validar o reajuste do Bolsa Família
item.description: The AGU filed a lawsuit with the STF to validate the constitutional amendment of the Bolsa Família increase, from R$ 600 to R$ 691, seeking legal stability and avoiding isolated decisions that may suspend the measure. The request, reported by Minister Gilmar Mendes, aims to centralize the discussion at the STF and reduce insecurity regarding the new benefit value.

item.title: Lula ou Flávio Bolsonaro, o vencedor indicará quatro Dinos ao STF
item.description: Legal expert Gilberto Morbach warns that both Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro risk undermining the Supreme Court by appointing four justices. He criticizes the Court for functioning as a parallel Congress influenced by political interests and highlights internal factional conflicts. The analysis reflects broader tensions between institutional integrity and partisanship in the 2026 electoral landscape.

item.title: Governo Lula pede que STF reconheça validade de reajuste do Bolsa Família
item.description: The Brazilian Union's Legal Advocacy Department (AGU) requested the Supreme Federal Court (STF) to validate President Lula's decree adjusting Bolsa Família benefits by 15%, correcting accumulated inflation since 2023. The increase raises the minimum benefit from BRL 600 to BRL 691 and the average value from BRL 675 to BRL 777, as a measure to restore beneficiaries' purchasing power. The action follows a petition by the Public Defender's Office and challenges from opposition lawmakers and presidential candidates.

item.title: Desaprovação de Lula atinge 45% no Lulômetro
item.description: President Lula's disapproval rating in the Lulômetro reached 45%,continuing its upward trend since Wednesday.The daily tracker,produced in partnership by O Antagonista and Real Time Big Data,shows that disapproval increased from 44% to 45%,while 'excellent and good' approval rose to 30%.

item.title: Ibovespa desvaloriza de olho em cenário fiscal brasileiro e preços do petróleo
item.description: The Ibovespa fell 0,41% to 185,2 thousand points, pressured by high international interest rates and fiscal uncertainties. Electoral polls show Flávio Bolsonaro advancing over Lula in 2026 scenarios, while oil prices drop for the third consecutive session.

item.title: Celina diz que vai à CVM contra Lula após falas sobre crise no BRB
item.description: The governor of the Federal District, Celina Leão (PP), announced legal action against President Lula over statements regarding the BRB crisis, calling them a crime. Lula, in turn, criticized Celina for shifting responsibility for the crisis to the federal government and questioned the governor's management.

item.title: Lula deve ir a Pernambuco antes do 1º turno após apelo de aliado e cenário eleitoral apertado no estado
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is expected to visit Pernambuco before the first round to support João Campos (PSB), following pressure from allies and a tight electoral scenario in the state. This decision diverges from the campaign's initial strategy of avoiding states with multiple supportive candidates. Governor Raquel Lyra (PSD) leads voter intentions, followed by Campos, in a race marked by accusations of disinformation and AI usage.

item.title: Reajuste do Bolsa Família fideliza eleitor mais do que vira voto, dizem analistas
item.description: Analysts say the 15% increase in Bolsa Família announced by the federal government is more likely to retain voters already supporting Lula than to attract new ones. Experts believe the measure aims primarily to combat voter abstention and reinforce PT's base, especially among direct beneficiaries of the social program. Its potential to sway undecided voters or those leaning toward other candidates is considered limited.

item.title: Elo de Milton Leite com empresas de ônibus é mais antigo do que diz ex-vereador
item.description: The relationship between former São Paulo City Council president Milton Leite (União Brasil) and bus companies dates back at least to the early 2000s, according to an investigation published on September 18, 2026. His closeness to the public transport sector may have influenced recent political decisions.

item.title: AGU pede que STF reconheça que decreto que reajustou valor do Bolsa Família é constitucional
item.description: The AGU asked the STF to recognize the constitutionality of the decree that adjusted Bolsa Família benefits by 15.04%, claiming the measure only preserves the real value of payments against inflation. The increase, raising the floor from BRL 600 to BRL 691, takes effect in October, between the two electoral rounds in 2026, generating criticism from candidates alleging electoral intent. The government emphasizes that the adjustment does not create new benefits or change eligibility criteria.

item.title: Lula rebate Trump e diz que não aceita classificar facções como terroristas
item.description: President Lula stated he does not accept the U.S. classification of the PCC and CV as terrorist organizations, reiterating his stance at an event in Rio de Janeiro. He emphasized the need for dialogue and international cooperation to resolve conflicts peacefully. Lula also criticized Trump's approach, rejecting policies that impact Brazil's sovereignty.
